title.narrative: Portfolio guarantee Kenya Support Refugee owned MSMEs

description.narrative:
The contribution is a guarantee program that is aimed to leverage private capital to support the development objectives of the Swedish Development strategy in Kenya. The strategy envisages a guarantee with KCB Bank in Kenya targeting access to finance for micro, small and medium sized companies, MSMEs, individuals and Village Savings and Lending Associations, VSLAs. A particular focus will be (i) enabling financing to the businesses owned by refugees, lending to MSMEs with KCB's Islamic banking product and conventional lending and (ii) enabling financing to MSMEs in relevant sectors owned by women, youth and for the start up companies. The overall purpose is enhancement of access to finance, job creation and improved overall economic growth.
The proposed intervention falls under the Strategy for Sweden'ss development cooperation with Kenya, 2021-2025. The support area relevant for this contribution is Economic development and protection systems that include the most vulnerable. The guarantee is also planned to be relevant for the support of the other two areas of the strategy, Climate change, the environment and resilience in the face of climate change and Human rights, democracy, rule of law, gender equality and sexual and reproductive health and rights.

Med denna insats (portföljgaranti) är målet att Sida ska öka tillgången till finansiering för mikro, små och medelstora företag, MSME, privatpersoner och Village Savings and Lending Associations, VSLAs. Ett särskilt fokus kommer att vara att möjliggöra finansiering till företag som ägs av flyktingar, utlåning till MSMEer med KCB:s islamiska bankprodukt och konventionell utlåning och möjliggöra finansiering till MSMEer i relevanta sektorer som ägs av kvinnor och ungdomar. Det övergripande syftet är förbättrad tillgång till finansiering, skapande av arbetstillfällen och förbättrad övergripande ekonomisk tillväxt. Sidas strategi i Kenya anger att man ska fokusera på bättre villkor för produktiv sysselsättning, anständiga arbetsvillkor och större ekonomiskt egenmakt, särskilt för kvinnor, unga och marginaliserade grupper inklusive flyktingar.

With this contribution (portfolio guarantee) Sida aims to increase access to finance for micro, small and medium sized companies, MSMEs, individuals and Village Savings and Lending Associations, VSLAs. A particular focus will be to enable financing to the companies owned by refugees, lending to MSME's with KCB's Islamic banking product and conventional lending and enabling financing to MSMEs in relevant sectors owned by women and youth. The overall purpose is enhancement of access to finance, job creation and improved overall economic growth. The Sida’s Strategy in Kenya stipulates to focus on better conditions for productive employment, decent working conditions and greater economic empowerment, especially for women, young people and marginalized groups including refugees.

The cumulative disbursed amount as of September 2026 is KES 973,709,099 (SEK 73,756,901). This demonstrates the strong catalytic effect of the guarantee facility. Rather than simply providing capital, the guarantee has helped mobilize substantially higher levels of lending. The disbursed amount illustrates that the guarantee is successfully crowding in private sector capital and expanding access to finance.
By enhancing the KCB's lending confidence, the guarantee has encouraged increased loan origination, larger loan portfolios and greater outreach to businesses that might not have obtained credit without the guarantee. This reflects the core objective of the guarantee which is using a limited amount of risk coverage to unlock multiples of additional lending in the market.
The scale of disbursement achieved to date indicates that the guarantee is not only facilitating individual loans but also strengthening the overall lending ecosystem. It demonstrates that the bank is actively leveraging the risk sharing arrangement to grow its lending activities, thereby amplifying the development impact of the guarantee. The continued growth in disbursements is evidence that the guarantee is serving as an effective catalyst for increased credit flow, supporting business growth, investment, job creation and broader economic development.
No indicator available - only a description of the activity results is published
